sources.title: Qwen 3.6: 35B vs 27B comparison - benchmark results
sources.snippet: I finally summed up all the Qwen 3.6 model test results I gathered over the past few days. I compared two models in detail: the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE, hybrid attention/delta) and the Qwen3.6-27B (dense, hybrid attention/delta).
